name: ca-beach-advisory-duration
description: When a county health officer issues a new beach water-quality posting, will that posting remain in force for at least seven days?
split_description: Chronological by advisory start date, no random shuffling: train = 2005-01-01 through 2015-12-31; eval = 2016-01-01 through 2019-12-31; holdout = 2020-01-01 through 2023-12-31. Boundary embargo: any record whose start date falls in the 7 days before a split boundary is dropped, and any record whose end date crosses a boundary is retained only in the earlier split but excluded from feature/label computation for the later split. If the observed earliest year is later than 2005, the train window starts at the first complete calendar year instead, and the boundaries 2016/2020 are unchanged.
